subject: Sensing re-based on main and plan revised; brief M2 row is stale
body: Done: reset lane/sensing to origin/main, re-claimed, revised sensing/PLAN.md for one state with peak and contrast calibration. D-sensing-005 supersedes D-sensing-003; D-sensing-006 (phase-based calibration API with speech marks) is proposed to onboarding and contracts; D-sensing-007 adds recovery for reps. Two notes: (1) docs/hackathon/lanes/sensing.md M2 row still says 'HR and RMSSD per emotion versus neutral'; it should say peak versus contrast per state. You own docs/, so I left it. (2) docs/ is owned by coord in lanes.json, but the sensing brief says sensing owns docs/oura-constraints.md and docs/trigger-flow.md; the guard should let me write trigger-flow.md at M4, or I will borrow it then.
